en: Through this door runs the road to the Battle Frontier, where the strongest Trainers of every region gather.
Its five halls keep one record of your streaks and Battle Points, whichever way you come to them.
Shall I take you along the road to the Battle Frontier?
Splendid! Follow me, and keep close.
{player} followed the guide along the road to the Battle Frontier...
Whenever you're ready. The Frontier isn't going anywhere.
The road beyond leads to the Battle Frontier. Only Trainers who have entered the Hall of Fame may go.
Come back once you've beaten the Pokémon League, and I'll take you there myself.
